PokerDualSettlement (on-chain secp256k1 EC_OP sigma verification) is the Phase 2 upgrade path (DUAL_PROOF_PROTOCOL.md v2.3); its Cairo code compiles and passes 89 snforge tests.

proof_policy.residual_trust: operator attests G-STARK validity until Phase 2 on-chain STARK verification

dual_proof.p: secp256k1 direct-sigma (ownership/shuffle/fold/reveal), challenge = keccak256, scalar = little-endian mod n, verified on-chain via the EC_OP builtin
dual_proof.g: stwo circle-stark (canonical tagged batches), host-verified; commitments bound via hand_binding

proof_policy.prover_service: not deployed for this submission: G-STARK generated and verified host-side by the operator (proving-tool); browser-verifiable via client-wasm proof bundles; on-chain G verifier is Phase 2

abi_notes.aggregate_digest_encoding: (felt252, felt252) dual felt; hi = be bytes[0..16], lo = be bytes[16..32]; rust: starknet_settlement::AggregateDigestFelts::split/merge
abi_notes.settle_hand_digest: single felt252 low-half projection; contract binds it to the registered dual-felt pair
abi_notes.settlement_commitment: poseidon over hand_id then (player, sign, magnitude)* per participant, address-ascending; rust: starknet_settlement::SettleHandCalldata
abi_notes.delta_encoding: i128 felt; negative values encoded as modular complement; magnitude bounded to u64
abi_notes.hand_binding_encoding: single felt252; poseidon_hash_many over the DUAL_PROOF_PROTOCOL.md §6 field order (domain tag poker_dual_hand_binding_v1, table/hand/players/deck-chain/reveal/state/settlement); rust: poker_texas_air::hand_binding
abi_notes.dual_ownership_proof_encoding: per player: 1 kind felt (=1) + 5 u256 (pk_x, pk_y, r_x, r_y, s); challenge derived on-chain as keccak256(G_compressed ‖ pk_compressed ‖ R_compressed) little-endian mod n; curve CurveId::Secp256k1 = 5, transcript TranscriptId::Keccak256 = 7
